001package bank.persistence;
002
003import bank.model.Bank;
004import bank.model.Customer;
005
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.util.List;
008
009/**
010 * ============================================================================
011 *  DataRepository.java
012 *  Owner: John (smartdude879@gmail.com)
013 * ============================================================================
014 *
015 *  ROLE:
016 *      The single "front door" to the bank's persisted state. Everyone else
017 *      (AuthService, TransactionService, InterestCalculator) talks to this
018 *      class — never to JsonStore directly.
019 *
020 *  USAGE PATTERN:
021 *      DataRepository repo = new DataRepository();
022 *      repo.load();                  // call once at startup
023 *      ...
024 *      repo.findCustomer("1001");    // used by AuthService
025 *      repo.save();                  // call after every change
026 *
027 *  WHY THIS WRAPPER EXISTS:
028 *      If we ever swap JSON for a database, only THIS class changes. The rest
029 *      of the app keeps working unchanged.
030 * ============================================================================
031 */
032public class DataRepository {
033
034    private final JsonStore store;
035    private Bank bank;
036
037    // ── Construction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
038
039    public DataRepository() {
040        this.store = new JsonStore();
041    }
042
043    /** Package-private constructor for testing with a stub JsonStore. */
044    DataRepository(JsonStore store) {
045        this.store = store;
046    }
047
048    // ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
049
050    /**
051     * Loads bank state from disk. Call once at program startup.
052     * If the file is missing or corrupted the bank is initialised empty.
053     */
054    public void load() {
055        this.bank = store.load();
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * Persists the current in-memory bank state to disk.
060     * Errors are logged — the program never crashes from a save failure.
061     */
062    public void save() {
063        if (bank == null) {
064            System.err.println("[DataRepository] save() called before load() — nothing to save.");
065            return;
066        }
067        try {
068            store.save(bank);
069        } catch (IOException e) {
070            System.err.println("[DataRepository] Failed to save bank.json: " + e.getMessage());
071        }
072    }
073
074    // ── Customer queries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
075
076    /**
077     * Finds a customer by their ID.
078     *
079     * @param customerId the customer's unique ID
080     * @return the matching customer, or {@code null} if no such customer exists
081     */
082    public Customer findCustomer(String customerId) {
083        assertLoaded();
084        for (Customer c : bank.getCustomers()) {
085            if (c.getId().equals(customerId)) {
086                return c;
087            }
088        }
089        return null;
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Returns every customer in the bank.
094     * Used by InterestCalculator to loop over everyone.
095     */
096    public List<Customer> allCustomers() {
097        assertLoaded();
098        return bank.getCustomers();
099    }
100
101    /**
102     * Adds a new customer to the bank.
103     * Throws if a customer with that ID already exists.
104     */
105    public void addCustomer(Customer customer) {
106        assertLoaded();
107        boolean exists = bank.getCustomers().stream()
108                .anyMatch(c -> c.getId().equals(customer.getId()));
109        if (exists) {
110            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
111                    "Customer with ID " + customer.getId() + " already exists.");
112        }
113        bank.getCustomers().add(customer);
114    }
115
116    // ── Low-level access ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
117
118    /**
119     * Returns the raw Bank object — avoid using outside of tests.
120     */
121    public Bank getBank() {
122        assertLoaded();
123        return bank;
124    }
125
126    // ── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
127
128    private void assertLoaded() {
129        if (bank == null) {
130            throw new IllegalStateException(
131                    "DataRepository.load() must be called before any data access.");
132        }
133    }
134}
